caption: Burcht, Leiden
composition: Open circular brick keep on a mound above the river split · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Burcht in Leiden is a circular brick shell keep with crenellations and no roof, standing on a grassy mound where the river branches meet. Trees cover the slope, and a stair climbs to a small gate. The sky is overcast, about 15.9°C, with wind near 7.9 km/h. Rapenburg is a different canal and is not in this frame.
